You're walking through a supply depot space station, when you encounter an Adama with a flashlight. What do you do?  I push him into the airlock, as the real Adama should still be aboard the Battlestar known as Galactica.

Your friend tells you that the Dark Watch is a better team than the Freedom Five, and Dark Watch Setback has the best power. Will you play a game with your friend?

I agree with him on the first point, then proceed to judge his humanity by extolling the virtues of Freedom Six Tempest.
